name: warthog-fbm
description: Warthog Fair Batch Matching (FBM) engine — C++/WebAssembly, strict-typed via a two-file Embind architecture.

scripts.build:wasm: cd .. && meson setup build-wasm --cross-file=crosscompile/emscripten.txt --prefix=/ --reconfigure && meson compile -C build-wasm
scripts.publish:assets: cp -f fbm.js fbm.wasm index.d.ts index.raw.d.ts dist/
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run stage && npm run build:ts && npm run publish:assets
